requirements_summary: Mid-market e-commerce SaaS. Primary need: improve on-site product relevance via a reranking endpoint that can run offline scoring and online low-latency reorders. Targets: tail latency < 150ms for single-item rerank, throughput up to 600 qps during peak, cost sensitive (look to reduce per-token spend via batching/caching). Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs for query scoring changes, KMS for key management, and ability to move from Hosted API POC to Dedicated VPC with reserved capacity.
